description: This Java class defines a LoRaWAN provider called FireflyProvider with methods for extracting device IDs, payloads, message types, normalized data, and additional data from JSON messages related to a Firefly LoRaWAN provider. It implements the LoraProvider interface and is annotated as a Spring @Component.

classes.name: FireflyProvider
classes.description: A Spring component implementing the LoraProvider interface, providing methods to process Firefly-specific LoRaWAN messages and extract data.

methods.name: extractDeviceId
methods.description: Extracts and returns the device EUI from the JSON message.

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Extracts and returns the payload string from the JSON message.

methods.name: extractMessageType
methods.description: Determines and returns the message type, specifically identifying 'confirmed_data_up' as UPLINK, otherwise UNKNOWN.

methods.name: extractNormalizedData
methods.description: Extracts various parameters such as spreading factor, function port, data rate, coding rate, frequency, frame count, and gateway info from the JSON message and returns them in a map.

methods.name: extractAdditionalData
methods.description: Returns a copy of the JSON message after removing spreading factor and function port keys (but in implementation returns null).
